units.source_text: 鹤川做了这样的回答，语调里没有流露丝毫的灰暗或自暴自弃的情绪。

en.t: Tsurukawa answered in this way, and not the slightest trace of gloom or self-abandonment showed in his tone.

units.source_text: 这时的闪电，映出他的脸庞上的惟一纤细的部分——细细的舒展的眉毛。

en.t: The lightning at that moment lit up the only delicate part of his face: his thin, gently extended eyebrows.

units.source_text: 看样子鹤川听任理发匠剃了眉毛的上下部分，于是，细细的眉毛便带有人工的纤细，眉梢的一部分还带着刚剃过的青色痕迹。

en.t: It seemed that Tsurukawa had let the barber shave above and below his eyebrows, so the slender brows had taken on an artificial delicacy, and part of their ends still bore the bluish marks of a fresh shave.
